parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` are test-fixture stub factories living in the `PlaylistTesting` source group of the `Playlist` package. The restraint rule is unambiguous: any cluster where even one record is a test fixture must be treated as intentional duplication. Here both records are test fixtures, so lifting them into a shared generic function would couple test-support infrastructure in a way that is neither necessary nor safe without a deliberate audit of each stub's domain-specific defaults.
